anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential CPU bottleneck or resource exhaustion.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which may indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.
Trading metrics such as totalPL, activeTrades, and winRate are all zero, suggesting inactivity or potential issues with trading operations.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent performance degradation and ensure system stability.
Review and potentially reconfigure AI strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and generating insights.
Evaluate current trading strategies and system configurations to ensure they are set up correctly and aligned with trading goals.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting the platform's reliability and user experience.

recommendations.action: Audit the AI system to diagnose why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities and make necessary adjustments.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity may hinder the platform's ability to adapt and optimize trading strategies, impacting profitability and competitiveness.

recommendations.action: Review and test the trading system to ensure it is operational and correctly configured to execute trades.
recommendations.rationale: Zero trading activity may indicate a configuration issue or a lack of market opportunities, which needs to be addressed to maintain trading operations.
